description:
Product Development uses design thinking & user experience methods to deliver breakthrough products and services that delight our customers. We bring innovative, exciting, and sustainable ideas to life.   We have opportunities around the world for you to contribute to advancements in autonomy, electrification, smart mobility technologies, and more!
 In this position...  
We are seeking a Test Automation Developer to build and maintain Python-based automated testing solutions for embedded automotive connectivity systems. This role combines hands-on software testing and development with the practical use of AI and LLM technologies to enhance requirements analysis, test design, automation, troubleshooting, and software quality.

 What you'll do... 
 Utilize LLM and AI tools to accomplish software analysis and development tasks.
 Apply AI-assisted techniques to support requirement analysis, test design, test automation, defect identification, troubleshooting, and test result analysis.
 Analyze product requirement documents for Connected Vehicle Applications and translate them into test cases that cover normal paths, error cases, boundary conditions, and unexpected events.
 Work in an Agile software development environment to deliver high-quality software solutions for cloud-connected in-vehicle modules operating on CAN and Ethernet networks.
 Design, implement, debug, test, and maintain Python-based test automation, including automated scripts that accurately implement test cases for Connected Vehicle Applications.
 Execute tests, debug issues, perform root cause analysis, and generate high-quality software defect reports.
 Establish and maintain test setups and automated test suite execution.
 Develop and maintain software tools, features, and test libraries that support automated testing and interface with vehicle ECUs.
 Interface with development and test teams to understand feature functionality and testing requirements.
 Devise test scenarios and implement automated test suites for maximum coverage.
 Review specifications and identify precise product requirements.
 Develop and execute functional and integration test plans for feature implementation.
 Automate test cases using Python and in-house libraries.
 Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers.
 Investigate and reproduce in-vehicle networking issues and verify software fixes.
 Contribute to team deliverables through involvement in Agile Scrum development sprints.
 Share ideas for innovation, AI-enabled opportunities, and process improvements.

 
 
 You'll have... 
 Bachelors degree in Computer or Electrical Engineering or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
 2+ years of demonstrated general understanding and practical utilization of Large Language Models and Artificial Intelligence.
 2+ years of experience applying LLM or AI tools to software analysis, development, testing, test generation, automation, or test result triage.
 2+ years of software test experience and/or tools development on embedded OS platforms such as Linux, QNX, or Android.
 2+ years of experience with test management tools such as TestRail, version control systems such as Git/GitHub, issue tracking systems such as JIRA, CI environments such as Jenkins, and corporate wikis such as Confluence.
 2+ years of experience in Python development and object-oriented design
 2+ years of experience mapping requirements and designs to test cases.
 2+ years of experience maintaining automated execution of large test suites and triaging test results.
 Even better, you may have... 
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
 Strong aptitude for troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal collaboration.
 Detail-oriented and adept at detecting and diagnosing software defects.
 Ability to work effectively in a multi-site team environment where self-direction and self-motivation are key.
 Experience with distributed systems, including embedded-to-cloud interactions.
 Experience with continuous integration systems such as Jenkins, testing frameworks, and shell scripting in Unix/Linux.
 Experience with data analytics and visualization.
 Experience with microcontrollers, electronics assembly, and debugging equipment.
 Working knowledge of AUTOSAR, CAN network technologies, automotive diagnostic protocols, Google Protobuf, and database testing.
 Experience with Ethernet, TCP, IP address assignment (DHCP), IP routing, DNS, firewalls, and NAT, including tracing and debugging tools such as Wireshark.
 Experience with test benches, hardware, and test tools.
 Familiarity with communication technologies and tools such as cURL, Wi-Fi, Cellular, and CAN.
 Experience in the automotive industry.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
• Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance
• Established and active employee resource groups
• Paid time off for individual and team community service 
• Generous vacation time, sick/personal time, and paid holidays, including between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day 
 This position is a salary grade 6 and ranges from $85,400-$143,200.     
Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.


For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR 
 Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
 Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1-888-336-0660.
 This position is hybrid with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week. #LI-Hybrid
